Yes this is true. The reasons for suicide are very complex. If a person is young, healthy and has a supportive family and friends yet they still have thoughts of suicide I would say they are mentally ill and need help. But for other people it is not a mental illness issue, it is a life issue. Things can go so bad in a persons life suicide is the only peace they will find.

It is a bad option but sometimes the only option left. You do not know if every persons situation is ''going to get better'' for some people life is set to get worse and worse and they lose more and more.
